scripts.build:tlmcmddb: tlmcmddb-cli bundle --pretty --component-name AOBC tlm-cmd-db/TLM_DB/calced_data tlm-cmd-db/CMD_DB tlmcmddb.json
scripts.run:kble: bash -c 'while :; do kble -s <(jrsonnet spaghetti.jsonnet); sleep 1; done'
scripts.run-real:kble: bash -c 'while :; do kble -s <(jrsonnet spaghetti.real.jsonnet -V=COM_PORT); sleep 1; done'
scripts.run-real:kble:docker: bash -c 'while :; do kble -s <(jrsonnet spaghetti.docker.real.jsonnet -V=COM_PORT); sleep 1; done'
